title: National Healthcare Properties, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: National Healthcare Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 10, 2026, announcing preliminary Q1 2026 estimates for its senior housing operating properties (SHOP) and outpatient medical facility (OMF) segments, along with authorization of Class A common stock for a proposed public offering. SHOP occupancy declined to approximately 83.8% from 84.6% in Q4 2025, while RevPOR increased to $6,275-$6,325 from $6,107, and Cash NOI Margin expanded to 21.0%-22.0% from 20.8%. OMF ending occupancy remained flat at approximately 94.0%.
key_points: SHOP average occupancy: ~83.8% for Q1 2026 vs 84.6% Q4 2025 and 81.0% Q1 2025
SHOP Cash NOI Margin: 21.0%-22.0% for Q1 2026 vs 20.8% Q4 2025 and 19.4% Q1 2025
OMF ending occupancy: ~94.0% as of March 31, 2026 vs 94.0% Q4 2025 and 93.5% Q1 2025
Company filed Articles Supplementary on April 10, 2026 authorizing up to 100,000,000 shares of Class A common stock for a proposed public offering
Preliminary estimates are subject to change and have not been audited or reviewed by the company's independent registered public accounting firm
